Restarts 33/50 Pace 93/100 Variety 66/100 Structure 96/150 Credibility 87/150 Engagement 61/100 Steadiness 66/100 9 dimensions , added up 665/1000 What you said 121 words filler vague said 3+ times So the thing about habits is, um, they compound. You do the small version every day and, like, it builds on its own. Um, the mistake people make is waiting to feel ready. You know, ready is a feeling that shows up after you start. I used to think discipline was the whole answer, and I would plan a week nobody could really do, then miss a day and quit the plan instead of the day. What changed was making the habit small enough that missing it felt stupid. Five minutes. Not an hour, just five minutes I can do standing in a kitchen. And the five minutes usually turns into more, but only because it was allowed to be five. 3 landed pauses Silence you chose, before a new point. Practice 2 of 3
